title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 093 ]

blocks.text: Killing animals for their fur is wrong. Consider the cute mink, the cuddly raccoon, the lovable harp seal. These animals haven't hurt us, so why should we savagely murder these adorable creatures? Think of a puppy. Picture its soulful trusting eyes. Would you want to wear Spot's hide on your back? The answer, from any thoughtful individual, must be a resounding "No."

readingSentences.english: Killing animals for their fur is wrong.
readingSentences.korean: 모피를 얻으려고 동물을 죽이는 것은 잘못이다.

감정이 가득 담긴, 믿음 어린 그 눈을 떠올려 보라.
